test_objective: If a subscription defines an entity type selection query, a notification shall be sent whenever an entity matches the query.

test_cases.name: 046_16_01 Check that a notification is sent with entity matching the entity type selection
test_cases.doc: If a subscription defines an entity type selection query, a notification shall be sent whenever an entity matches the query.
test_cases.then:
then {
    the client at '${endpoint}' receives a valid Notification containing:
        Notification received After waiting '5' seconds     and
        Notification received Notification data: '${notification}[subscriptionId]' equal to '${subscription_id}'     and
        Notification received Notification data: '${notification}[data][0][id]' equal to '${entity_id}'     and
        Notification received The dictionary `${notification}' should contain the key 'data'     and
        Notification received The variable `${notification}[data]' should not be '${EMPTY}'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/ld+json' and
 payload defined in file: 'building-simple-attributes.jsonld'
}
